Default evaluation-time grid

Source: R/times-grid.R
default_times.Rd

Builds the time grid used by the verb-level functions (predict(), evaluate(), tune(), compare(), interpret()) when the caller does not pass times explicitly. The grid spans the observed event times so that integrated metrics (IBS, IAE, ISE) and survival-curve summaries are computed over the region where the data are informative.

Usage

default_times(time, status = NULL, n = 50L, range = c(0.05, 0.95))

Arguments

time

Numeric vector of observed follow-up times.

status

Optional 0/1 event indicator aligned with time. When supplied, the grid is built from event times only; otherwise all positive times are used.

n

Integer; maximum number of grid points (default 50).

range

Two-value probability vector giving the lower and upper quantiles of the event-time distribution spanned by the grid (default c(0.05, 0.95)), which trims unstable tails.

Value

A numeric vector, strictly increasing and positive, of length at most n.

Details

The chosen grid is recorded on every result object (res$times) and printed, so that runs remain reproducible and comparable even though the default is data-dependent.

Examples

default_times(veteran$time, veteran$status)
#>  [1]   7.000000   8.000000   8.030612  10.347959  12.000000  13.026531
#>  [7]  15.345918  18.000000  19.000000  20.000000  21.000000  24.000000
#> [13]  25.000000  26.348980  30.000000  31.000000  34.344898  42.005102
#> [19]  44.337755  48.670408  51.000000  52.000000  52.668367  54.002041
#> [25]  59.667347  68.996939  79.992857  82.663265  88.992857  94.990816
#> [31]  99.000000 101.986735 109.974490 111.327551 117.000000 121.971429
#> [37] 132.325510 139.658163 143.990816 153.970408 162.000000 176.854082
#> [43] 200.321429 223.848980 241.854082 265.748980 285.608163 339.602041
#> [49] 379.904082 390.950000
default_times(veteran$time, veteran$status, n = 10)
#>  [1]   7.00  15.00  23.50  35.45  52.15  83.70 111.00 145.75 230.85 390.95
